issues.title: Ingest Grant County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $16,459,926 across 33 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($5,793,933), County Road Fund ($4,754,414), Emergency Medical 2017 Tax Fund ($1,235,585). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
